## Individual assignment 4
rubric={correctness:1}

The purpose of this assignment is to ensure that every gets more feedback on their
projects, as well as gives everyone the opportunity to practice giving feedback. 
**Peer review is due Friday, December 11 at 11:59 pm PT** so that it might be useful in improving the final project. Providing it even earlier would be even more useful, so please do this if you can! *The peer review activity should take no more than 45-60 min to complete.

**Important: Your feedback must be respectful and polite while being constructive.**

### Submission instructions

You must submit a `.html` version of this homework to Canvas. To programmatically render your notebook to html and submit the assignment to Canvas, open [submit.ipynb](submit.ipynb) and use the instructions there.

### Exercise 1

Look up the project you were assigned to review here: [https://github.ubc.ca/MDS-2020-21/DSCI_522_dsci-workflows_students/issues/17](https://github.ubc.ca/MDS-2020-21/DSCI_522_dsci-workflows_students/issues/17)

Spend 30-45 min reviewing the project, and then spend ~ 15 min opening a GitHub issue and giving 2-3 
pieces of polite, respectful and constructive feedback.

When completing your peer review consider the project rubric which it will be graded on, as well as the guidelines outlined below:

-	Documentation: Is the project properly documented? (Possible answers: It needs more work / Somewhat / Yes it is great). Where should the documentation be better?
-	Code: Does the code work? Is it readable? Are the results from it reproducible? (Possible answers: It needs more work / Somewhat / Yes it is great). How could the code be improved?
-	Analysis and reasoning: Is the analysis correct? (Possible answers: It needs more work / Somewhat / Yes it is great). Are there any errors in the analysis/reasoning that should be fixed/improved? 
-	Communication: Is the report clear and easy to follow? Are the aims of the analysis and conclusions communicated correctly?
-	Suggestions: Provide a specific suggestion for the author on how to improve any of the categories listed above where there is room for improvement.



To prove that you did this, paste your url to the GitHub issue you opened below **and** include a screenshot of the issue in the rendered version of the markdown document.
